observation_summary: The getIterations() method consistently returned 0 regardless of the actual number of iterations performed by the optimization algorithm.
reasoning_summary: The bug was caused by the failure of various optimizer implementations to increment the iteration counter during their optimization loops. While the base class provided a mechanism for tracking iterations, the individual optimizer classes (such as LevenbergMarquardtOptimizer, PowellOptimizer, etc.) were either using local variables that were not reflected in the global state or failing to call the required increment method entirely. The fix involved replacing local iteration counters with calls to the 'incrementIterationCount()' method provided by the base class and ensuring the convergence checkers used the global iteration count.
